name: Where single-cell foundation models help: a public-data benchmark of annotation, in silico perturbation and gene regulatory inference
description: A public-data benchmark of single-cell foundation models, CellOracle, supervised perturbation models and simple baselines on cell-type annotation, in silico perturbation and gene regulatory network inference.

limitations: GRN result rests on five hubs. CRISPRa effect-size correlation is ρ = 0.30. Five foundation models were benchmarked.
